Major Giving

Jim Obergefell & John Arthur Society

Leadership circle
Equality Ohio Education Fund

Strategic, smart giving focused on trans youth, statewide legal protections, supporting our elders, and curbing bullying — named for the plaintiffs whose fight brought marriage equality to Ohio and the nation.

Learn About the Society

Buttons link to Equality Ohio’s current live giving pages. In the production build, giving flows are embedded on-site. Tax-deductibility language (Education Fund 501(c)(3) vs. Equality Ohio 501(c)(4)) will be finalized with EO’s development team.
